name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Success, Implementation & Account Management
summary: Client success and implementation professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, owning the client lifecycle from contract through launch, ongoing service, and renewal. Onboarded and launched 25+ clients a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets while leading a team of up to 20, and retained ~94% of a 15-20 partner book at Birdeye, including channel sales to healthcare-focused agencies. Builds implementation plans, onboarding documentation, and status reporting, coordinates product, engineering, and operations teams to hit launch dates, and runs business reviews that tie performance to growth. Earlier built compliance and customer-management systems from scratch as co-owner of a licensed medical marijuana dispensary.
